_meta.description: PDX preset catalogue for the OneHealth Cross-border Importation sub-module and the wbepi simulator. Maintained by the PDX core team.
_meta.maintained_by: Isaias Fernandes Co (technical), WHO AFRO HEP

strain_presets._description: Pathogen-specific parameter priors for the SEIRD ensemble. R0_mean and R0_sd parameterise a truncated normal distribution; cfr_min and cfr_max parameterise a uniform distribution. Used by the wbepi simulator's R0-ensemble mode.

ebola_zaire.label: Ebola virus disease (Zaire)
ebola_zaire.note: Reference: 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak; 2018-2020 Kivu epidemic.

ebola_bundibugyo.label: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo)
ebola_bundibugyo.note: Reference: 2007 Bundibugyo Uganda outbreak; 2012 Orientale DRC outbreak. Used for Ituri 2026 calibration.

mpox_clade_i.label: Mpox (clade I)
mpox_clade_i.note: Reference: DRC endemic clade Ia; 2024 clade Ib emergence in eastern DRC.

lassa.label: Lassa fever
lassa.note: Reference: Nigeria, Sierra Leone, Guinea endemic transmission. CFR much higher in hospital settings.

corridor_presets._description: Pre-tuned cross-border importation inputs for known outbreak corridors. Updated quarterly from IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix Flow Monitoring data.

countries.name: Uganda
countries.note: Direct Mahagi-Goli-Paidha border. Strong national EVD response history; PoE screening at 22 sites. Vulnerability concentrates in West Nile border districts (Zombo, Nebbi, Arua).

countries.name: South Sudan
countries.note: Direct Aru-Mahagi border with Yei River and Morobo counties. Lowest readiness of any neighbour; severe IPC and coordination gaps in border facilities; active refugee bidirectional flow.

countries.name: Rwanda
countries.note: No direct Ituri border. Pathway is indirect (Ituri -> North Kivu -> Goma -> Rusizi/Cyanika). High national readiness.

countries.name: Burundi
countries.note: No direct Ituri border. Pathway only via North/South Kivu transit. Lowest crossing volume; importation probability lowest of the four.

countries.name: Rwanda
countries.note: Petite Barriere and Grande Barriere at Goma-Gisenyi: highest crossing volume in eastern DRC.

countries.name: Tanzania
countries.note: Kigoma and Kagera regions via Lake Tanganyika.
